reading: The emergency excess in haemolysis has three candidate causes that travel together: cannula draws, collector role and pneumatic tube transport. The published evidence on cannula draws conflicts (claim c3), plausibly because technique and collector training vary, while transport speed has its own effect (claim c4). The laboratory's own data can separate site, collector role and transport but not collection method (claim c5), so a local study cannot answer the method question on which a policy would rest.
